# VPN SHOP v1.4.0 — Extended Telegram button accent colors

- Adds **pink, yellow, purple, orange, cyan, brown and black** accent choices for each bot menu button.
- Unlike native blue/green/red button backgrounds, these additional choices use a matching colored emoji prefix on a neutral Telegram button, because Telegram does not support arbitrary keyboard button background colors.
- Preserves purchased plans, checkout paths, configured button labels, previous keyboard messages, languages and hidden menu options.
- The bot administration panel provides the expanded color selector and an honest preview of the neutral Telegram buttons and their colored markers.
- Adds backend validation, storefront routing tests, frontend preview tests, and translations across all 13 panel languages.

No additional images were generated or added.
